issue.title: just lint is red on master: symvision reports progress_fingerprint unused
issue.description:
Discovered by epic sase-fa's land agent while running the static gates before closing the epic. NOT caused by sase-fa (which touched none of these files) and not tracked by any bead: it comes from master commit 840cdff10 'fix(commit-finalizer): break async-wait deadlock in finalizer passes' (SASE_PLAN=202608/finalizer_async_wait_deadlock.md, no SASE_BEAD footer), which landed 2026-08-05 18:03.

Reproduction at master 840cdff10 with a fresh 'just install':

    $ just lint
    ...
    Unused public functions/classes. Make these private if they are used only within the file they are defined...:
      progress_fingerprint in src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer_git.py
    error: recipe `_lint-symvision` failed on line 273 with exit code 1
    error: recipe `lint` failed on line 248 with exit code 1

ruff and mypy (2749 files) both pass; symvision is the only failing gate, so every agent that runs 'just check' on master hits it.

The symbol is not actually dead: src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer.py calls it at lines 250 and 291, but through the module alias imported at line 16 ('from . import commit_finalizer_git as finalizer_git' -> 'finalizer_git.progress_fingerprint(dirty_state)'). Symvision resolves consumers through 'from X import name' bindings, so attribute access on a module alias does not count as a use.

Scope (mechanical): add progress_fingerprint to the existing 'from .commit_finalizer_git import (...)' list at src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer.py:25 and call it unqualified at both sites, which gives symvision a consumer it can see. Per sase/memory/symvision.md the alternatives are worse here: the symbol has a real cross-file consumer so it cannot be made private, and a pragma is only for consumers symvision cannot discover. Confirm with 'just symvision', then 'just check'.

evidence.note: Independent corroboration during epic sase-fb land audit. Phase sase-fb.3-1 (finalize phase, commit 980bdd337) hit the same failure after rebasing its finalizer changes onto 840cdff10, and independently confirmed via a clean worktree that symvision fails identically at 840cdff10 before its own change — i.e. pre-existing and unrelated to sase-fb. Diagnosis matches exactly: progress_fingerprint is consumed only via the finalizer_git module-alias attribute access in commit_finalizer.py, not a direct import, so symvision can't see the consumer.

Independently reproduced during test-suite scaling research (agent research.z, workspace sase_14 at 256da2887, fresh 'just install'): 'just _lint-symvision' exits 1 with progress_fingerprint in src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer_git.py. Still unfixed at origin/master 02dee2182 (two commits past the report), so master has been red for ~40min of agent activity. Confirms the alias-access diagnosis: commit_finalizer.py:258,300 call finalizer_git.progress_fingerprint(dirty_state). Impact datapoint: symvision is 15.2s of the ~35s of non-test gates in a warm 'just check' and is currently the only red gate, so every agent that changes a file fails 'just check' at lint before reaching the 6-minute test stage.

Independent corroboration from epic sase-fl's land agent. Both phase sase-fl.1 (commit 75a1ffc10) and sase-fl.2 (commit 4895b8f32) hit this identically after rebasing onto master, and the land agent reconfirmed by running 'just symvision' fresh at HEAD (b5c78f972, after all three sase-fl phases landed): still fails identically — 'progress_fingerprint in src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer_git.py' is the only reported unused-public-symbol. Confirms this remains unfixed and pre-existing/unrelated to sase-fl.

Independent reproduction during epic sase-fc's land audit on 2026-08-05 at master 4330fd0d5 (one commit past the last report) with a fresh 'just install': 'just check' is red at the symvision stage and never reaches the test stage. Verbatim: 'Unused public functions/classes ... progress_fingerprint in src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer_git.py', error: recipe `_lint-symvision` failed on line 273 with exit code 1. fmt (python), fmt (markdown), keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, and changelog all pass, so symvision remains the only red gate. Confirms the alias-access diagnosis at the current HEAD: src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer.py:16 does 'from . import commit_finalizer_git as finalizer_git' and calls finalizer_git.progress_fingerprint(dirty_state) at lines 258 and 300. Epic sase-fc is purely bead-time presentation and touches none of these files; it was originally proposed as a follow-up by phase sase-fc.7, which independently confirmed it reproduces on a clean stash of master.
